entries.content: A 2023 meta-analysis in JAMA Psychiatry found that app-based mindfulness interventions showed moderate effect sizes for reducing symptoms of mild anxiety and improving subjective well-being in non-clinical populations. Researchers noted that engagement duration correlated with reported benefits.

Quick update on my practice. Still doing 20 minutes every morning and the journaling prompts have been great for noticing patterns in my thinking. Had a weird few weeks in November where I felt off despite keeping up with everything. Ended up talking to someone about it and turns out there was some stuff from years ago I hadn't really processed. Anyway, back on track now and the combination has been working well for me.
